knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Only the outlets set aside for vacuuming should be used, and equipment must not be disconnected to make room.
A red dot signals the door stays locked throughout the vacuuming, from start to finish, so it must not be changed.
A bag left until it is full loses suction, so it is replaced at about two-thirds full.

practicalCriteria: Checks the bag, filters, cord and plug, and fits the harness, before plugging in.
Vacuums in a fixed route, corners and edges before anything else, and lifts and returns each bin.
Uses only the marked outlets, does not disconnect equipment, and leaves each door as its dot requires.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 per cent pass mark, so all three must be correct. The practical sign-off is separate, observed by an assessor, and is not shown by a quiz result.
evidenceRequired: Observed practical sign-off on assessor sheet
Job record or photo of the finished area
stopWorkCriteria: Machine used with a damaged cord or missing earth pin
Equipment unplugged to free an outlet
